Asphalt Calculator

Asphalt calculator: driveway length, width and compacted thickness to cubic yards and tons of hot mix asphalt.

Asphalt tonnage

Hot mix asphalt is sold by the ton. Compacted HMA typically weighs about 145 lb per cubic foot (roughly 110 lb per square yard per inch of thickness). Tons = L × W × thickness(in) ÷ 12 × 145 ÷ 2,000.

Example: 50 × 12 ft at 3 in = 150 cu ft × 145 = 21,750 lb ≈ 10.9 tons.

Typical thickness

  • Residential driveway: 2–3 in of asphalt over 6–8 in compacted aggregate base
  • Heavier traffic: 4 in or a two-lift system

Most of a driveway's lifespan depends on drainage and the base, so ask your contractor about base depth, not just asphalt thickness.
